synth.notes:
Ring (player) A1/A2 moves y+-6 carrying blocks on the beam; the whole move cancels if a pushed chain would leave the colour-4 field.
Beam (arm) A4/A3 changes w by +-6. Hook = any block on the beam rows at x == tip-4, with no tag check. The hook drags every block fully on the beam. The step-87 counterexample is todo blocks being dragged.
An unhooked extend pushes the blocks in the swept strip. A blocked horizontal chain leaves the beam to move alone. The arm A4 no_change case = beam already at max w (field right edge).
Tags: a hooked next alone on the beam becomes collected; a collected block off the beam reverts. Legend centre 2x2 = 0 while collected. Clicks are no-ops.
HUD bar 3s = (n-1)//3 for n non-click actions. n is remembered per returned frame to handle out-of-order steps; fallback is 3*bars+1, or 0. Stateless, the rule gets 49/70.
